description: Disproved independent physical bank retained as a migration tombstone. 0x596F0C is character-battle visual matrix rows 27..31.
verification_method: The canonical 62x9 matrix starts at 0x596D5C with 16-byte rows; 0x596F0C = 0x596D5C + 27*16. Its five pointer tuples exactly equal character 4 visual slots 0..4 in character-battle-visuals-v1. Consumer 0x0807B220 selects this same five-row subview through the generic 16-byte allocator, proving a logical view of the canonical matrix rather than a separate physical bank.
notes: The former five records were a valid but duplicated alias view, not an independent resource table. Legacy resource-pointer editor rows remain diagnostic-only; edit the canonical character battle visual matrix instead.
